title: Personio - Rigid reporting and opaque pricing that scales with apps and headcount
clean_text: Users report that existing reports cannot be copied and filters are limited, with limited customization options affecting flexibility for specific organizational needs; some workflows are described as rigid, requiring admin-level steps even for small configuration changes. Users also express frustration over a lack of essential features around employee performance and feedback management. Pricing transparency is a recurring complaint: Personio's pricing is not public, requires contacting sales, and scales with both employee count and selected apps, making early-stage cost comparison against competitors harder.
